transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in today?

Well... I guess I'm here because... most days I just wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling in my chest. It's hard to explain. Just... like the old Ruben, the guy who could talk to anybody and actually enjoy the day... he's just gone.
How long have you been feeling this way?

About... eight months, I guess. Give or take. It started around the time they brought in a new regional manager at work. He started coming down on me... taking away accounts I’ve handled for years. So... yeah. About eight months.
Do you notice that your mood is worse at certain times of the day, like in the morning when you first wake up?
I don't know. I haven't really... paid attention to the clock. It just sort of feels the same all day, I guess.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with friends?

I guess so. I used to look forward to things... bowling, working out in the garden. Taking my wife to gallery shows, or going dancing... but now... I don't know. I just sit there. I mostly just make excuses not to go. It just... none of it really feels worth the effort anymore.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight over the past few months?
I haven't really noticed. I mean, my wife makes dinner and I eat it, I guess. I haven't been on a scale or anything.
Have you found yourself feeling guilty or blaming yourself for things more than usual, or feeling like you’re not worth much?

...I guess so. I just... I keep telling myself I'm useless now. Like... all those years I spent taking care of my clients, providing for my family... it just feels like none of it counts. Not when I can't even seem to handle the job anymore. So... yeah. I guess I do.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or maybe feeling restless and unable to sit still?
...No, I don't think so. I haven't really noticed anything like that. I'm not restless, anyway. I mostly just... stay in my chair.
Have you ever felt so low that you've thought about ending your life or wished you were dead?

...I don't know. I mean... sometimes I just think... maybe it would be easier. For them, I mean. My wife and kids. If I just... didn't wake up. It's... I don't really want to talk about it. It just scares me a little, I guess. I don't really trust myself right now.
Have you noticed that you feel more tired or that you have less energy than usual, even when you haven't done anything particularly strenuous?
...Not really. I mean... I don't do much of anything right now. Like I said, I mostly just sit there. So I haven't really noticed feeling more tired. I just... I don't know.
Would you say that you’ve completely lost interest in all activities, or that nothing gives you pleasure anymore?

...Yeah, I guess. I used to... well, I used to like doing things. Bowling, working out in the garden. I used to take my wife to these gallery shows, or we'd go dancing sometimes. But now... I just don't. I just sit there. I make up excuses not to go because... I don't know, none of it really feels worth the effort anymore. I just don't care.
Have you noticed that your movements or speech have slowed down a lot, or maybe that you can’t seem to sit still lately?
...No, I don't think so. Like I said, I mostly just sit in my chair. I haven't really noticed moving any slower than usual. And I don't feel restless or anything. Just... sitting.
Even when you’re not doing much, do you feel like you have less energy or more fatigue than usual?
...I think you asked me that already. I just... I don't know. Like I said, I'm not doing enough to get tired. So I haven't really noticed feeling fatigued. I'm just sitting there.
Even though you're not doing much right now, do you feel like you have less energy than before or a lot more fatigue?
...Like I said, you already asked me that. I don't know. I'm just... I'm just sitting. I don't feel tired because I'm not doing anything.
Have you ever had periods where you felt unusually high, extremely energized, or so irritable that people noticed something was off?
...No. I've never felt like that. Never had any extra energy or anything.
Would you say that you’ve completely lost interest in all activities, or that nothing gives you pleasure anymore?

...Yeah. I guess. I used to look forward to things... bowling, working out in the garden. Taking my wife to gallery shows, or going dancing, things like that. But... I don't know. Now I just sit there. I just make excuses not to go. None of it really feels worth the effort anymore.
Would you say that you’ve completely lost interest in all activities, or that nothing gives you pleasure anymore?

I... I thought I just answered that. But, yeah. Like I told you, I used to look forward to things. Bowling, working in the garden, taking my wife out dancing... but now I just sit there. I just make excuses not to go. None of it feels worth the effort anymore.
Have you noticed any trouble focusing, making decisions, or thinking clearly lately?
...No. Not really. I guess my thinking is fine. I can make a decision if I have to. I just... haven't had much reason to lately.
Have you ever felt this way before, like you've lost interest in everything and can't enjoy anything, or is this the first time you've experienced something like this?
...No. Never like this. It's... it's the first time.
